subject.title: fix(cron): preserve delivery thread id type across SQLite round-trip

question: Should maintainers accept the additive cron SQLite `delivery_thread_id_type` column as the durable contract for preserving `CronDelivery.threadId` string-versus-number identity?
rationale: The patch looks correct, but persisted-state schema changes and delivery-routing semantics are compatibility-sensitive and require maintainer ownership before merge.

options.title: Accept the typed-column migration
options.body: Land this fix after ordinary gates because it preserves the existing `string | number` contract without using stale `job_json` as a runtime fallback.

options.title: Choose a different storage contract
options.body: Pause the PR if maintainers do not want a permanent type marker column and want another durable representation instead.

recommendation.title: Accept the typed-column migration
recommendation.body: Land this fix after ordinary gates because it preserves the existing `string | number` contract without using stale `job_json` as a runtime fallback.
